name: Fight Flight
detailed_description: Fight Flight is a 3D Flight Simulator Game that takes you around the world flying a plane. You can either shoot enemy planes in real life places, or just fly around the world for fun, you choose! Locations are randomly chosen along with randomized weather, either your flighting clear skies or your heading out in the rain you will have to see.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Core i5-7300U 3.5 GHz, AMD Ryzen 3 3300U, or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960, AMD R9 280, or equivalent DX11 GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires SSD for Optimal Rendering. Needs an internet connection to render world data.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Core i5-7300U 3.5 GHz, AMD Ryzen 3 3300U, or equivalent
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3070, AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT, or equivalent GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires SSD for Optimal Rendering. Needs an internet connection to render world data.
